title: Complai
tagline: Automate your crypto tax compliance and optimize your returns with smart insights.

prizes.title: Best Use of Symbiotic Relay SDK

description: Complai is an AI-powered platform that helps crypto users automatically comply with tax regulations, optimize their tax outcomes, and understand the real financial impact of their on-chain activity. It connects to wallets, exchanges, and DeFi protocols to categorize transactions, calculate gains and losses, detect taxable events, and surface opportunities for tax optimization. Complai removes the complexity of crypto taxes by offering real-time insights, automated reporting, and personalized suggestions—making compliance effortless for everyday users and power traders alike.
how_its_made:
This project uses embedded wallet from Coinbase CDP for user authentication.
Once logged in user can browse different AAVE vaults and deposit into them and also insure them using Symbiotic's Relay SDK - user deposits premium and then aave services are constantly monitored and if they go down user gets payout.
User can also chat with AI assistant specializing in crypto tax and see  their assets and portfolio.
